description: Purchasing of potatoes by the M/s Co-operative Wholesale Establishment directly from local farmers and sell them to consumers through M/s Lanka Sathosa Limited
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-18 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In order to protect local potato farmers with a fair market price, the Government has currently imposed a Special Commodity Levy of Rs.80/- per kg on the importation of potatoes. At the beginning of the harvesting season in the Nuwara Eliya and Badulla districts, middlemen and wholesale purchasers impose a farm gate price of Rs.200/- to Rs.220/- per kg of potato, and this price is likely to fluctuate with the increases in harvest volume in the coming days. Considering the need to protect and promote the local supply of essential food items in the country in the best and most appropriate manner, it has been planned to purchase potatoes directly from local potato farmers by M/s Co-operative Wholesale Establishment and sell the stocks to Lanka Sathosa Limited and release them to the market through the retail outlet network of Lanka Sathosa. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation and the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development to implement the proposed methodology, subject to purchasing a maximum of 1,000 kg of potato per farmer, was approved by the Cabinet.
